# Dreamsign Replacement Dialog

Surfaces & Overlays · Live demo & interactive props: `/cumulus#/dreamsign-replacement-dialog`

Real consumers: **4** (imports outside `src/cumulus/docs/` and tests).

A UUID-routed capacity-resolution dialog that keeps the incoming and held Dreamsigns fully readable.

> **Guidance:** Selection emits a held Dreamsign UUID; capacity and mutation rules stay with the caller.

Reading a Dreamsign uses the Entity Reveal coordinator while the explicit action selects it for replacement.

The selected value is the held Dreamsign UUID, never its position or display name.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | `DreamsignReplacementModel` | yes | — | Complete resolved replacement presentation. |
| `onDreamsignPress` | `(dreamsignId: string) => void` | yes | — | Reports the exact held Dreamsign UUID selected for replacement. |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` | yes | — | Dismisses the replacement workflow without selecting a held Dreamsign. |

### `model`: the `DreamsignReplacementModel` model

| Field | Type | Optional | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `incoming` | `LocalizedDreamsign` | no | The newly acquired Dreamsign awaiting capacity resolution. |
| `held` | `readonly LocalizedDreamsign[]` | no | Held Dreamsigns, each resolved by UUID. |
| `capacity` | `number` | no | Prepared maximum held-Dreamsign count. |
| `dismissLabel` | `LocalizedString` | no | Label for the non-destructive dismissal action. |
| `closeLabel` | `LocalizedString` | no | Accessible label for the dialog close control. |

## Usage

```tsx
<DreamsignReplacementDialog model={replacement} onDreamsignPress={replaceById} onDismiss={cancel} />
```
